stemMd: A formal museum notice states, "Visitors may use pencils in the study room. Pens are prohibited to protect the collection." Which sentence best matches its tone?

options.label: A
options.textMd: We are totally serious about the munchies situation.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Food is, like, a huge no-no in this place.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Please leave food and beverages outside the study room.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Keep your snacks outta here, folks!

explanationMd: The notice uses direct, courteous instructions in standard language. The request to leave food and beverages outside maintains that register.

distractorRationale.b: The fillers and informal phrasing are inconsistent with the notice.
distractorRationale.d: The slang and exclamation clash with the formal notice.
distractorRationale.a: The conversational slang clashes with the surrounding instructions.
